1. Exemption is allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. This is a criminal appeal under Section 374 Cr.P.C., 1973 assailing the judgment of conviction dated 31.07.2023 and order on sentence dated 21.08.2023 passed by the learned Trial Court,
